name: pulse
label: pulse
description: Pulse: nostr notifications. Personal push notifications for nostr events (mentions, replies, zaps, dms) straight to your phone as an installable pwa.

requiredConfig.name: pulse domain
requiredConfig.description: public domain for this notification hub; open it on your phone and add it to your home screen to receive pushes. identity, relays and notification rules are set in the app itself.

requiredConfig.name: ntfy domain
requiredConfig.description: domain for the bundled ntfy server — the google-free push channel. the ntfy app on android/grapheneos connects here directly, no play services involved.
